prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1091; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above, which involved a low-speed head-on impact. Our client sustained injuries in the accident and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communications regarding this claim to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide written confirmation of the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, together with a certified copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm whether any other policies, including umbrella or excess coverage, may apply.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, repair and total loss records, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file notes, and any other material that may bear on liability or damages. Please ensure that no vehicle or component involved in the collision is repaired, salvaged, or destroyed without advance written notice to this office.
